title: Sample Bank — Corporate Lending Policy
notice: Fictional demonstration policy. A compliance result is not a bank credit approval.
repayment_method: Equal monthly instalments at a fixed illustrative annual interest rate of 12%, excluding fees. Annual proposed debt service equals 12 monthly instalments, including for terms below 12 months (conservative annualisation).

clauses.title: Operating history
clauses.text: The company must have operated for at least 3 years.

clauses.title: Permitted industry
clauses.text: Gambling and speculative finance companies are ineligible.

clauses.title: Permitted loan purpose
clauses.text: Loans may fund working capital, equipment or business expansion only.

clauses.title: Loan amount
clauses.text: Requested principal must be between INR 500,000 and INR 50,000,000 inclusive.

clauses.title: Loan tenure
clauses.text: The repayment term must not exceed 60 months.

clauses.title: Annual revenue
clauses.text: Latest annual revenue must be at least INR 10,000,000.

clauses.title: Loan to revenue
clauses.text: Requested principal must not exceed 30% of annual revenue. Zero revenue fails this clause.

clauses.title: Debt service coverage
clauses.text: Annual operating cash flow divided by existing annual debt service plus annualised proposed debt service must be at least 1.25.

clauses.title: Collateral coverage
clauses.text: Collateral value must be at least 125% of requested principal.

clauses.title: Company credit score
clauses.text: The demonstration company credit score must be at least 700 on a 300–900 scale.

clauses.title: Default history
clauses.text: There must be no credit defaults in the last 3 years.

clauses.title: Audited financial statements
clauses.text: Audited financial statements for the latest 2 financial years must be available.
